features.quote: Max horizon: 30 agent turns or explicit termination signal, whichever comes first.

features.justification_quote: Cost and token budgets logged; trials exceeding $X (TBD) capped and flagged.

features.quote: Prompt sensitivity: small wording changes in the agent prompt can shift quit rate dramatically; any future prompt iteration requires a fresh baseline.

features.quote: Data contamination: tasks must be newly generated or heavily mutated versions of public problems; verify no model has seen the exact contradiction before.
